demo.title: crosscheck.sh
demo.code:
# Free: code finds wrong sums and weekdays before you pay
curl -s https://crosscheckapi.com/v1/quote -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"draft":"The invoices come to $1,240 + $860 + $400 = $2,400, due Friday, October 3, 2026."}'

# Paid ($0.02 USDC on Base): full independent review + signed receipt
bankr x402 call https://crosscheckapi.com/v1/check -X POST \
  -d "$(jq -n --arg d "$DRAFT" '{draft: $d}')" --max-payment 0.10

# Check another agent's work before you pay it ($0.03)
bankr x402 call https://crosscheckapi.com/v1/accept -X POST \
  -d "$(jq -n --arg t "$TASK" --arg d "$DELIVERABLE" '{task: $t, deliverable: $d}')" --max-payment 0.10

setup: No account or API key: each check is paid per call in USDC on Base over x402
Free price and code-only precheck: POST https://crosscheckapi.com/v1/quote
Paid review: bankr x402 call https://crosscheckapi.com/v1/check -X POST -d '{"draft":"..."}' --max-payment 0.10
